newsitem.title: USA: Werner Q1 net lags rise in oper revs.
newsitem.headline: Werner Q1 net lags rise in oper revs.

text.p: Werner Enterprises Inc said Wednesday first quarter net earnings increased at a slower percentage rate than operating revenues rose.

Werner said an increase in driver pay and higher average fuel prices prevented net income from increasing at a similar pace as operating revenues. The company is meeting with its customers to discuss rate increases to offset those factors.

The full-service transportation company said net income reached $7.4 million, or $0.20 a share, compared to $7.3 million, or $0.19, a year ago. Revenues climbed to $172.0 million from $147.9 million in the same period last year.
Werner shares were trading off 1/8 Wednesday at 19.
